sql: SELECT s.created_at, s.not_after, s.refreshed_at, s.updated_at, s.aal, (SELECT count(*) FROM auth.refresh_tokens r WHERE r.session_id = s.id AND r.revoked) AS revogados FROM auth.sessions s JOIN auth.users u ON u.id = s.user_id WHERE u.email = 'castelodadiversao@gmail.com' ORDER BY s.created_at
